purpose: Phase-7C innate-immunity structure: macrophages, natural killer (NK) cells, dendritic cells (DC). Macrophages use a CONTINUUM polarization tendency (never a binary M1/M2 switch). NK and DC separate availability / presence / activation / competence / suppression from net potential. Section 1 establishes the contract; calculation is a later section (UNAVAILABLE for now). Schematic normalized [0,1]; no cell count or marker level (NOT_REPORTED).

polarization_axis.note: -1 = strongly tumour-supporting, +1 = strongly tumour-opposing, 0 = mixed; signed continuum, not a binary switch.

coefficient_policy.valid_range: normalized stages in [0,1]; macrophage polarization axis in [-1,1]
coefficient_policy.source: general innate tumour-immunology biology applied predictively
coefficient_policy.sensitivity_note: cytotoxic potential is derived AFTER availability/activation/suppression are established, never assumed from availability alone.
coefficient_policy.limitations: No macrophage/NK/DC count or marker (all NOT_REPORTED).
